ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into as of 10th day November, 2015 between Dina Realty LLC, having an address at 2149 East 72 Street, Brooklyn, NY 11235, (hereinafter called as "Owner"), and SHS Ralph LLC, having an address at 651 Willowbrook Road, Staten Island, NY 10314, (hereinafter called as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land with the building and improvements thereon, located in the County of Kings, the City and State of New York, known as Lot 85 in Block 7932 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, the County of Kings and known as and by the street address 1410 Ralph Avenue, Brooklyn, New York and more particularly described on Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, building and improvements being hereinafter called the "Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land with the buildings and improvements thereon located in the County of Kings, the City and State of New York, known as Lot 90 in Block 7932 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, the County of Kings and known as and by the street address 1414 Ralph Avenue, Brooklyn, New York and more particularly described on Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, buildings and improvements being hereinafter called the "Developer Parcel"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new commercial building upon all or a portion of the Developer Parcel (said new building. with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter called the ^New Building"; the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); and WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (hereinafter called as the “Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended (hereinafter called as the “Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to the Developer Parcel as an independent zoning lot, with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining the Developer Parcel and Owner Parcel into a single zoning lot solely for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with such limitation; WHEREAS, there exist Transferred Development Rights (hereinafter defined), which are appurtenant to the Owner Parcel, which are in excess of the Development 1

Rights utilized by the building and improvements located thereon and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution.As used in this Agreement, the of the Development Rights. The term “Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting or adding thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor area ratio established for structures in the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located, (ii) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and (ii) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of from time to time; and WHEREAS, in order to construct the New Building with the excess bulk on the Developer Parcel, Developer acquired 2,000.00 square feet of the Transferred Development Rights from the Owner Parcel pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot Merger Purchase and Sale Agreement between Developer and Owner dated as of November 10, 2015, (the “Effective Date"), on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth therein, NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and for other and good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: ARTICLE1 DECLARATION OF ZONING LOT RESTRICTION Section 1.1 The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restriction, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, (hereinafter called as the “Declaration"), a copy of which Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit “C" and made a part hereof, which seek to effectuate the intentions of the parties set forth in preamble to this Agreement by creating a single Zoning lot, (hereinafter as the “Single Zoning Lot") consisting of both Owner Parcel and Developer Parcel.
